name: mindang

creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: READ FIRST: styles/mindang/WORKFLOW.md (token-lean workflow) and ENGINE.md (every engine rule this style needs). Do not reread the short-editing references.
Origin: measured on @mindang.com19 (https://www.instagram.com/reel/De4D7stBc8T/), 2026-10-26, see STYLE.md. Talking-head format profile: video-agent/formats/talking-head/PROFILE.md.

Layout: paper only all along (layout.keys [[0, 1920]]) with the speaker CUT OUT (cutout, no room) standing at the bottom centre, head top about y 1090, face (hair to chin) 24 to 26 % of the frame, chest cut by the frame bottom. Never the camera card, never a split.

Stage: the top half (y 230 to 900) holds ONE board per idea: a serif header line (Noto Serif Display, ink, one italic word in the accent) above white rounded UI cards (r 24, soft shadow) that change state on the words. Elements blur/fade in .25 s, never slide or bounce.

Captions: Montserrat Bold ~62 px, sentence case, the whole 2 to 4 word chunk at once (band, no block, hard in/out), one line centered at y ~1010 (between the board and the head), ink #191813. ONE accent-blue word per line (captions.emph, shown in captions.hi). Over a dark or video beat the band stays ink: hide the captions there (captions.hide) and write the line white inside that beat's own component at y ~1480.

Stickers: a short serif italic phrase in the accent inside a thin accent-bordered white box, tilted -3 to -6 deg (rot -.06 to -.1 rad), popping in on the word ('15 phút', 'vài phút', '100+ trang'). One at a time.

Full-screen screen recording: hard cut to the real UI full frame (bg paper-blue gradient), slow zoom/pan to the element the voice names; a numbered step pill top-left ('1 Tải tài liệu lên Gemini'); yellow highlighter on the lines named and blue question chips. Captions stay at y ~1010 in ink.

Real B-roll (own footage of the action told: working late, typing): hard cut, full frame, 4 to 6 s, a running clock chip top-right ('☾ 22:40', dark rounded pill, mono white) and a white paper tag top-left with a serif italic accent word ('tối khuya'). Captions white at y ~1480. No footage: a clock board instead (dial + serif '2 tiếng').
Result beat: dark flat background #191813, '✓ Kết quả' serif italic accent title at y ~330, the result screen as a wide card in the middle, captions white at y ~1480.

CTA: on the cutout, a white checklist card ('Bộ prompt' + boxes ticking on the words) and a black speech bubble 'comment "KEYWORD"' (serif italic keyword); the giveaway card with a blue 'miễn phí' tag last.
Cuts: hard cuts only, about one shot change every 3.8 s (10 cuts in 42 s), no fade, no whip, no glitch. Zoom: none on the talking head (face size constant), no punch-in, no push.

Sound: voice only up front (-14 LUFS); a barely audible bed about 26 dB under the voice (measured: voice -17.4 dB, mix in pauses -43.5 dB). No sound effects on cuts, boards or stickers (none on the spectrogram).
Serif = Noto Serif Display (assets/fonts, has Vietnamese diacritics); sans = Montserrat (assets/fonts). Never Instrument Serif or Poppins for Vietnamese text.
